_comment: Local-fork overlay. The upstream merged metadata does not publish DELETE /im/v1/chats (disband group); scripts/fetch_meta.py merges this method into the im.chats resource after every fetch.

delete.description: 解散群聊。调用后群聊立即解散、所有成员被移出，且无法恢复。Identity: supports `user` and `bot`; only the group owner can disband; a bot must be the owner of the group it created.

chat_id.description: 群 ID。获取方式：;;- [创建群](https://open.feishu.cn/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/reference/im-v1/chat/create)，从返回结果中获取该群的 chat_id。;- 调用[获取用户或机器人所在的群列表](https://open.feishu.cn/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/reference/im-v1/chat/list)接口，可以查询用户或机器人所在群的 chat_id。;;**注意**：仅支持群模式为 `group` 的群组 ID。
